_about: Which bus routes count as Dhaka City routes for the Favourite Bus module. The buses table has no city field, so a route is a Dhaka City route only when EVERY stop passes both checks: (1) its name is not in outsideCityStops, the stops in the route data known to lie outside the two city corporations (DNCC and DSCC), and (2) it lies inside cityBounds, a safety net so a new stop with an unknown name far outside the city is never counted as Dhaka City. Edit this file to correct a classification; it is read when the server starts.
